title: Colour combinations
slide_intent: Show how to evaluate a color pairing at the size where the seal will appear. A combination that reads at large scale may lose detail when reduced.
strategic_value: The palette can give the institution variety while keeping the seal’s lettering legible in different settings.
demonstration: Four labeled rows compare white, black and dark green seals on colored fields, then colored seals on white. A note calls attention to lower-contrast combinations and scale.
practical_value: Look up a proposed seal and background pairing in the relevant row and consider the final scale for combinations with lower contrast.

content_islands.name: Palette guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and short notes in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Combination matrix
content_islands.spec: Label four rows by foreground and background. Use swatches and small seal specimens at a common scale so a reader can scan across each row.

content_islands.name: Scale note
content_islands.spec: Place the lower-contrast callout near the colored-on-white specimens it qualifies.

reference_purposes.Intent: The lower-contrast callout ties larger-scale use to accessibility.
reference_purposes.Expression: The matrix exposes the range of seal-and-background color combinations.
reference_purposes.Application: Rows organize suggested combinations by white, black, dark green and colored foregrounds.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The callout qualifies the lower-contrast mint and pink seals on white by requiring consideration at larger scale.

ingredient.name: Seal and background pairing
ingredient.role: Preserve the seal’s lettering and line detail as colors change.
ingredient.application: Use the suggested combination matrix to select foreground and background. Consider lower-contrast colored seals on white at a larger scale, as the callout directs.
ingredient.scope: The parent museum seal in the illustrated palette combinations. The page gives no numerical contrast ratio or minimum size for these pairings.
